_comment: Coverage priority matrix, quality-score components, and the D-5 Repository Certification policy (spec Part 07 + owner decision D-5). The certification gate (repository_audit.py --certify) reads targets + policy from here; it is the SOLE authority for REPOSITORY_READY_FOR_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_GENERATION and defaults to NOT certified until real coverage exists.

quality_score_weights._comment: Repository quality score (0-100). Components sum to 1.0.

certification_policy._comment: D-5. certified=true ONLY when ALL of these hold. Default (empty/partial repo) => NOT certified. A single dry-run file cannot certify because per-board Priority-A coverage will be far below target.
